description: This PHP script initializes the database for an HR management system (OrangeHRM) by deleting existing employee and user records, then inserting predefined employee and user data, including an admin account and sample employee accounts. It includes database connection setup, data truncation, data insertion, and output messages.

classes.name: Conf
classes.description: A class to handle database configuration parameters such as host, user, password, database name, and port.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method for the Conf class to initialize database configuration parameters.
